home.title: Master your own bodyweight
home.subtitle: A monthly membership: train any day the gym is open and follow a program built by your coach.

auth.pitchText: Check your subscription, follow your training program and track your progress.
auth.newHere: New here? Create an account, then pay your first month at the gym. The coach activates your subscription when the payment is recorded.

payments.title: Payments
